planning_scheme.name: Toowoomba Regional Planning Scheme
planning_scheme.notes: Council page: "The current Toowoomba Regional Planning Scheme version 29 took effect on 21 July 2026." PDF footers: "21 July 2026 – v29.0 – Toowoomba Regional Planning Scheme". The scheme commenced 1 July 2012 (Citation and commencement). TLPI 01/2026 (Table of Assessment for Building Work) commenced 16 February 2026 and replaces the accepted-development-subject-to-requirements part of Table 5.7:1. QHC: no reference to the Queensland Housing Code was found in Parts 1, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 or Schedule 1 of v29; the scheme refers only to QDC MP1.1/MP1.2. Treated as NOT adopted (the Building Regulation 2021 s106 transition keeps MP1.1/MP1.2 for this scheme).

qdc_qhc_relationship.summary: Part 1 s1.6 Table 1.6.1 lists the only s33 Building Act alternative provisions: the Small Lot Housing Design Code (9.3.10) AO3.1 (front setback, alternative to QDC MP1.1 P1) and AO4.1 (side/rear, alternative to MP1.1 P2). It also lists s32(b) qualitative/quantifiable standards: AO12.1 (privacy, P5), AO7.1/7.2 and AO8.1/8.2 (car parking, P8) and AO9.1 (open space, P9). All apply to dwelling houses on lots < 450 m2. No zone code, local plan or overlay setback is an alternative provision. Elsewhere QDC MP1.1/MP1.2 apply to Class 1 and Class 10 siting, and some zone AOs (LDR AO9.2, LMDR AO9.2, Township AO6.2) expressly defer to the QDC. The Neighbourhood Character Overlay Code is the referral-agency amenity/aesthetics provision (Table 1.6.2). No QHC adoption found.

definitions.text: setback, for a building or structure, means the shortest distance, measured horizontally, between the outermost projection of the building or structure to the vertical projection of the boundary of the lot where the building or structure is.
domestic outbuilding means a non-habitable class 10a building that is— (a) a shed, garage or carport; and (b) ancillary to a residential use carried out on the premises where the building is.

dwelling house means a residential use of premises involving— (a) 1 dwelling for a single household and any domestic outbuildings associated with the dwelling; or (b) 1 dwelling for a single household, a secondary dwelling, and any domestic outbuildings associated with either dwelling.

definitions.term: main face (Small Lot Housing Design Code)
definitions.text: The ‘main face’ of the dwelling is the closest non-garage/carport dwelling element to the front boundary (such as the main building façade, or a first-floor balcony that faces the street (if provided).

local_plan_mechanism.summary: Part 7 local plans: Highfields, Meringandan and Meringandan West; Glenvale; Charlton Wellcamp Enterprise Area. Local plan codes are listed as benchmarks only for code-assessable development (local plan codes prevail over zone codes, s1.5). Only the Charlton Wellcamp Enterprise Area code has numeric building setbacks (AO13.1/AO14.1, industrial area). The Highfields and Glenvale codes state no numeric front/side/rear setbacks reaching Class 10. Schedule 7 Approved Plans of Development (not reviewed) can apply instead of the Small Lot code.

open_questions: Small Lot Housing Design Code AO4.1 refers to "Table 9.3.10:3", but the setback table is 9.3.10:2 (9.3.10:3 is built-to-boundary wall length). Confirm the intended reference with council.
Table 9.3.10:2 lot-width bands overlap ("≤ 12.5 metres" and "> 12 metres"); both give 1.2 m, so the result is the same.
Rural Zone AO1.1 "Non-residential buildings": does it reach a domestic shed ancillary to a dwelling house (Class 10a), or only farm/non-residential buildings?

Under TLPI 01/2026, building work not associated with an MCU is accepted subject to requirements against "the applicable zone code". It is unclear whether council applies assessable-only zone code tables (e.g. LDR Table 6.2.1:3 setbacks) to such Class 10 building work. The accepted-development parts (Tables 6.2.1:1 / 6.2.2:1) contain no setbacks.
Schedule 7 Approved Plans of Development were not reviewed; they may contain estate-specific setbacks.
